text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1943219876 - Stripe webhook delivery errors spike (5xx + 429). Automated webhook retry backlog growing, webhook status: throttled by Stripe due to quota/billing enforcement.

sara (oncall): I'm on it. seeing 5xx and 429 from stripe to our webhook ingestion endpoint. Errors started ~1943219800, ramped up. Root path /hooks/stripe/event-receiver.

dan (sre): Confirmed. Logs show a mix of 502/504 and 429s. Sample: `2026-03-15T14:20:04Z GET /hooks/stripe/event-receiver 502 "upstream reset"` and `429: quota exceeded`.

sara (oncall): Priority? customer-facing auth/payments degradation reported for a subset of merchants — some are seeing failed invoice webhooks (so billing retries / UI missing events). Impact: delayed entitlement updates, sign-in/payment flows for affected customers.

tyler (payments): We're seeing retries in our jobs queue and a handful of escalations to support. Stripe sent a notice about temporary quota enforcement on the merchant account due to unusual event replay rates. They recommend decreasing retry aggressiveness.

dan (sre): Quick mitigation checklist:
- flip ingestion to polling fallback for critical merchants (reduce webhook reliance)
- enable outbound backoff on our webhook relay to avoid getting more 429s
- pause noisy replays from internal backfill jobs
- open support case w/Stripe with request id and sample timestamps

sara (oncall): Doing the paged handoff: @tyler you own merchant comms & Stripe escalation. @dan you own runtime mitigations. I'll coordinate paging and status.

tyler (payments): On it. I'm opening the Stripe support ticket now. Will include account ids, sample event IDs, and ask for temporary quota lift or guidance. Contact: stripe-escalations@stripe.com.

alice (support): Drafting a note for impacted customers. Short message: "We're aware of delays for some payment events due to webhook delivery issues with our payment provider. We're working on a fallback and will update ETA." Need a list of affected merchants — Tyler can you drop IDs.

dan (sre): Switching plan -> start polling fallback for top 50 merchants by revenue and for those with recent payments activity. Command I'm running:```bash
# enable polling for tenant ids in POLL_FALLBACK list
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  https://console.internal/api/tenants/fallback/poll -d '{"tenants": ["m-123","m-456","m-789"]}'
```
Will also ramp down our webhook retry worker concurrency:```yaml
worker: webhook-retry
concurrency: 2
backoff: exponential
max_retries: 3
```

sara (oncall): Add to runbook: runbook/webhooks-fallback.md -> paging rules and rollback. I'm updating incident channel and will create a public status page entry.

d an (sre): (typo) dan (sre): Also enabling request-level caching for idempotent events so replays don't hammer upstream. Enabling KV cache for `event_id` lookups.

incident-bot: deploy-bot triggered canary config update 1943220100: webhook-retry-worker concurrency set to 2 in prod (deploy id: canary-324).

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary deploy succeeded on 3/4 regions. Monitoring.

sara (oncall): Tyler, update when Stripe responds. Dan, status of polling switchover?

dan (sre): Polling kickoff done for first 25 merchants. Metrics: webhook failure rate for those tenants dropped from 18% -> 3% after poll switch. Backlog processing paused for low-revenue tenants.

tyler (payments): Stripe responded: they confirmed quota enforcement tied to a merchant account flagged for high retry rate. They can lift limit for a short window if we demonstrate reduced retry rate and provide a mitigation plan. I've asked for 2-hour lift to drain backlog.

alice (support): Draft outgoing status for customers ready, short + actionable + no overshare. Will paste here for review: "We're experiencing delayed payment events due to delivery throttling by our provider. We're switching impacted merchants to a polling fallback and expect event delivery to resume shortly. If you have urgent invoices, please contact support."

sara (oncall): +1. Keep it <=2 sentences. Post to status page and copy to customers impacted list.

dan (sre): Monitoring live metrics. Dashboard panels: `webhook.errors.5xx`, `webhook.errors.429`, `polling.success.rate`. Setting alert to auto-close when 5xx < 1% and 429 < 1% for 15m.

tyler (payments): Stripe granted 1.5 hour temporary lift pending our backoff proof. I'm coordinating with them on a gradual drain plan and will escalate if needed. Also asking for logs they can share re: throttled webhook deliveries.

sara (oncall): On-call handoff in 30m. I'll summarize actions for next oncall: what changed (polling enabled for critical merchants, retries dialed to 3, backlog pause for low-rev tenants, Stripe temp lift requested), where to look (dashboards + runbook link), comms status, and who to page.

alice (support): Sent initial customer comms to impacted list. Will update after drain.

dan (sre): Quick note for postmortem: root cause likely combined: a noisy merchant + aggressive internal replay/backfill + provider's quota enforcement. Need to add a preemptive circuit-breaker to our retry worker and an automatic polling fallback for merchants when webhooks degrade.

sara (oncall): Agreed. For now we keep this as INCIDENT P2 — high customer impact but partial mitigation in progress. If drain fails or Stripe denies lift, escalate to P1.

t yler (payments): Stripe contact just posted extra logs. uploading to the incident doc now.

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> P2, annotated timeline created.

sara (oncall): Ending comms for this thread — handoff to night oncall in 30m. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
